_about: Recipe values (dotted paths into presets/<process>_<alloy>.json) each phase needs, and why. A job refuses to run a phase while any of its values is null. A new alloy needs only a preset file with these filled.

ingate_candidates.why: ingate in the drag (below the parting plane) or the cope (above)
shortest parting-line patch an ingate may sit on
ingate thickness through the parting plane
candidates closer than this merge into one
a section thinner than this, straight ahead of an ingate, is flagged as impinged
how far ahead of an ingate a core or thin wall counts as impinged
the alloy's ingate rule tags (e.g. feeds_heaviest_zone)
an ingate must run at least this far out from the part clear of it, to reach a runner

layouts.why: sand above the cavity in the cope
sand below the cavity in the drag
pattern allowance: cavity footprints are the casting scaled up by it

runners.why: runner in the drag or the cope
runner height / width at the parting plane
runner top face narrower than its bottom (draft)
runner run-on past the last ingate
metal height in the cup above the sprue top
ingate thickness; its width comes from the area
cavities are the casting scaled up by it

assembly.why: sprue well diameter / sprue bottom diameter
sprue well depth below the runners
draft on cup, well and ingates
